fixes.explanation: Aaron the priest is the one. God tells Moses to speak to the Levites: "…from these you are to give the LORD’s offering to Aaron the priest." The Israelites give the tithe to the Levites, and then the Levites hand part of it up to Aaron. So the Levites receive AND give. That's a whole line of hands passing things along, and I love to see it.

problems.problem: The final line turns the Levites’ offering into a scolding about standing around with hands out. It sounds preachy and casts receiving in an unkind light.
